entities.name: Sigebert of Gembloux
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sigebert or Sigibert of Gembloux was a medieval author, known mainly as a pro-Imperial historian of a universal chronicle, opposed to the expansive papacy of Gregory VII and Pascal II. Early in his life he became a monk in the Benedictine abbey of Gembloux, now situated in Belgium.
